Ужасеся небо о семъ, и солнце лучи скры; ты же Израилю не устыдѣлся еси, но смерти мя предалъ еси: отпусти имъ, Отче святый, не вѣдятъ бо что сотвориша
incipit_english: Two evils hath My first-born son Israel committed: he hath forsaken Me, the fountain of living water, and digged for himself a broken cistern; Me he crucified upon the Tree, but Barabbas he begged and released. Heaven was astonished at this, and the sun hid its rays; yet thou, O Israel, wast not ashamed, but didst deliver Me unto death: forgive them, O Holy Father, for they know not what they do
